item.text: {"action":"write","arguments_json":"{\"path\":\"work.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Evaluate state-transition requests against a supplied policy.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n\\ndef evaluate(request, policy):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Return the result of applying *request* under *policy*.\\n\\n    Neither argument is modified. An edge marked as a retry requires a\\n    non-boolean integer attempt count within the policy's half-open retry\\n    range.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    edge = policy.get(\\\"edges\\\", {}).get(\\n        f\\\"{request.get('from')}>{request.get('to')}\\\"\\n    )\\n    if edge is None:\\n        return {\\\"ok\\\": False, \\\"value\\\": None, \\\"reason\\\": \\\"blocked\\\"}\\n\\n    required_role = edge.get(\\\"role\\\")\\n    if required_role is not None and request.get(\\\"role\\\") != required_role:\\n        return {\\\"ok\\\": False, \\\"value\\\": None, \\\"reason\\\": \\\"permission\\\"}\\n\\n    if edge.get(\\\"retry\\\"):\\n        attempts = request.get(\\\"attempts\\\")\\n        retry_limit = policy.get(\\\"retry_limit\\\")\\n        if (\\n            type(attempts) is not int\\n            or type(retry_limit) is not int\\n            or not 0 <= attempts < retry_limit\\n        ):\\n            return {\\\"ok\\\": False, \\\"value\\\": None, \\\"reason\\\": \\\"retry_limit\\\"}\\n\\n    return {\\\"ok\\\": True, \\\"value\\\": request.get(\\\"to\\\"), \\\"reason\\\": \\\"ok\\\"}\\n\"}"}
